how_it_works.title: Field-Tested 3-Step Detection Loop
how_it_works.subtitle: Built for low-bandwidth rural conditions with rapid expert escalation
how_it_works.step1_desc: Capture affected leaves, stems, or fruit directly in the field with camera or offline cache.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Vision models identify pathogen signatures while live meteorology computes 7-day spore risk.

field_notes.title: Field Dispatches from Growers
field_notes.note1: Got the alert two days before my neighbor even noticed downy mildew. Sprayed only the affected 4 rows instead of the entire 6-acre plot, saving ₹14,000 in fungicide.
field_notes.note2: The weather forecast warned of a thrip surge after Sunday's humidity drop. Blue sticky traps caught them early before bulb formation was hit.
field_notes.author2: Balaji Rao — Guntur, Andhra Pradesh (Chili & Cotton)
